```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  fig.path = "figures/"
)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r load-packages}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(openxlsx)
library(knitr)
```

```{r load-data}
data(lung, package = "survival")
data(pbc, package = "survival")
data(colon, package = "survival")

cat(sprintf("lung:  N=%d, variables=%d\n", nrow(lung), ncol(lung)))
cat(sprintf("pbc:   N=%d, variables=%d\n", nrow(pbc), ncol(pbc)))
cat(sprintf("colon: N=%d, variables=%d\n", nrow(colon), ncol(colon)))
```

```{r export-raw}
raw_dir <- "/home/rstudio/project/data/raw"
dir.create(raw_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(lung, file.path(raw_dir, "lung_raw.csv"))
write_csv(pbc, file.path(raw_dir, "pbc_raw.csv"))
write_csv(colon, file.path(raw_dir, "colon_raw.csv"))

cat("Raw data exported to:", raw_dir, "\n")
```

```{r lung-missing}
lung_covariates <- c("time", "status", "age", "sex", "ph.ecog",
                     "ph.karno", "pat.karno", "meal.cal", "wt.loss")
lung_sub <- lung[, lung_covariates]

missing_count <- colSums(is.na(lung_sub))
missing_pct <- round(missing_count / nrow(lung_sub) * 100, 1)
lung_missing_tbl <- data.frame(
  variable = names(missing_count),
  n_missing = missing_count,
  pct_missing = missing_pct
)
kable(lung_missing_tbl, caption = "lung: 欠損値集計", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r lung-missing-heatmap, fig.height=4}
lung_na_mat <- is.na(lung_sub) * 1
lung_na_df <- lung_na_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(-row_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "is_missing")

ggplot(lung_na_df, aes(x = variable, y = row_id, fill = factor(is_missing))) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey90", "1" = "#E64B35"),
                    labels = c("0" = "Observed", "1" = "Missing")) +
  labs(title = "lung: 欠損値パターン", x = NULL, y = "行番号", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r lung-distributions, fig.height=8}
lung_cont <- lung_sub %>%
  select(age, ph.karno, pat.karno, meal.cal, wt.loss) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

ggplot(lung_cont, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4DBBD5", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "lung: 連続共変量の分布") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r lung-categorical, fig.height=4}
lung_cat <- lung_sub %>%
  select(sex, ph.ecog) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

ggplot(lung_cat, aes(x = factor(value))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#3C5488", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "lung: カテゴリカル共変量の分布", x = NULL, y = "度数") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r lung-survival-dist}
cat(sprintf("lung 生存時間: mean=%.1f, median=%.1f, range=[%d, %d]\n",
            mean(lung$time), median(lung$time), min(lung$time), max(lung$time)))
cat(sprintf("イベント率 (status==2): %.1f%% (%d/%d)\n",
            sum(lung$status == 2) / nrow(lung) * 100,
            sum(lung$status == 2), nrow(lung)))
```

```{r lung-time-hist, fig.height=4}
ggplot(lung, aes(x = time, fill = factor(status))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1" = "#4DBBD5", "2" = "#E64B35"),
                    labels = c("1" = "Censored", "2" = "Dead")) +
  labs(title = "lung: 生存時間の分布", x = "Time (days)", y = "Count", fill = "Status") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r lung-km, fig.height=5}
lung_km <- lung %>% mutate(event = status - 1)
km_lung <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ 1, data = lung_km)
ggsurvplot(km_lung, data = lung_km,
           title = "lung: Kaplan-Meier 曲線",
           xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "Survival Probability",
           risk.table = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE,
           palette = "#3C5488")
```

```{r lung-preprocessing}
lung_vars <- c("time", "status", "age", "sex", "ph.ecog",
               "ph.karno", "pat.karno", "meal.cal", "wt.loss")
lung_raw <- lung[, lung_vars]

n_before_lung <- nrow(lung_raw)
events_before_lung <- sum(lung_raw$status == 2)

lung_prepared <- lung_raw %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(status = status - 1L)

n_after_lung <- nrow(lung_prepared)
events_after_lung <- sum(lung_prepared$status == 1)
n_excluded_lung <- n_before_lung - n_after_lung

cat(sprintf("lung 前処理:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  除外前: N=%d, events=%d\n", n_before_lung, events_before_lung))
cat(sprintf("  除外後: N=%d, events=%d\n", n_after_lung, events_after_lung))
cat(sprintf("  除外行数: %d\n", n_excluded_lung))
```

```{r lung-verify}
stopifnot(all(lung_prepared$status %in% c(0, 1)))
stopifnot(sum(is.na(lung_prepared)) == 0)
cat("lung: status 0/1 check PASS, no missing values\n")
summary(lung_prepared)
```

```{r pbc-preprocessing}
n_before_pbc <- nrow(pbc)
events_before_pbc <- sum(pbc$status == 2)

pbc_prepared <- pbc %>%
  select(all_of(c("time", "status", "age", "sex", "trt", "ascites", "hepato",
                  "spiders", "edema", "bili", "chol", "albumin", "copper",
                  "alk.phos", "ast", "trig", "platelet", "protime", "stage"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(trt)) %>%
  mutate(status = as.integer(status == 2))

n_after_pbc <- nrow(pbc_prepared)
events_after_pbc <- sum(pbc_prepared$status == 1)
n_excluded_pbc <- n_before_pbc - n_after_pbc

cat(sprintf("pbc 前処理:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  除外前: N=%d, events(status==2)=%d\n", n_before_pbc, events_before_pbc))
cat(sprintf("  除外後: N=%d, events=%d\n", n_after_pbc, events_after_pbc))
cat(sprintf("  除外行数: %d (trt=NAの非ランダム化患者)\n", n_excluded_pbc))
```

```{r pbc-imputation}
pbc_na_before <- colSums(is.na(pbc_prepared))
cat("=== pbc 補完前の欠損 ===\n")
print(pbc_na_before[pbc_na_before > 0])

pbc_impute_vars <- c("chol", "copper", "trig", "platelet")
pbc_impute_values <- list()

for (var in pbc_impute_vars) {
  med_val <- median(pbc_prepared[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  n_imputed <- sum(is.na(pbc_prepared[[var]]))
  pbc_prepared[[var]][is.na(pbc_prepared[[var]])] <- med_val
  pbc_impute_values[[var]] <- list(method = "median", value = med_val, n = n_imputed)
  cat(sprintf("  %s: median=%.1f, imputed %d values\n", var, med_val, n_imputed))
}

cat(sprintf("\npbc 補完後: 完全症例 %d/%d\n",
            sum(complete.cases(pbc_prepared)), nrow(pbc_prepared)))
```

```{r pbc-verify}
stopifnot(all(pbc_prepared$status %in% c(0, 1)))
stopifnot(sum(is.na(pbc_prepared$trt)) == 0)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(pbc_prepared)) == 0)
cat("pbc: status 0/1 check PASS, no missing values\n")
```

```{r colon-preprocessing}
n_before_colon <- nrow(colon)

colon_prepared <- colon %>%
  filter(etype == 1) %>%
  select(all_of(c("time", "status", "sex", "age", "obstruct", "perfor",
                  "adhere", "nodes", "differ", "extent", "surg",
                  "node4", "rx")))

n_after_colon <- nrow(colon_prepared)
events_after_colon <- sum(colon_prepared$status == 1)

cat(sprintf("colon 前処理:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  全レコード: N=%d\n", n_before_colon))
cat(sprintf("  etype==1 サブセット後: N=%d, events=%d\n",
            n_after_colon, events_after_colon))
```

```{r colon-imputation}
colon_na_before <- colSums(is.na(colon_prepared))
cat("=== colon 補完前の欠損 ===\n")
print(colon_na_before[colon_na_before > 0])

colon_impute_values <- list()

med_nodes <- median(colon_prepared$nodes, na.rm = TRUE)
n_imp_nodes <- sum(is.na(colon_prepared$nodes))
colon_prepared$nodes[is.na(colon_prepared$nodes)] <- med_nodes
colon_impute_values[["nodes"]] <- list(method = "median", value = med_nodes, n = n_imp_nodes)
cat(sprintf("  nodes: median=%.1f, imputed %d values\n", med_nodes, n_imp_nodes))

mode_differ <- as.integer(names(sort(table(colon_prepared$differ), decreasing = TRUE))[1])
n_imp_differ <- sum(is.na(colon_prepared$differ))
colon_prepared$differ[is.na(colon_prepared$differ)] <- mode_differ
colon_impute_values[["differ"]] <- list(method = "mode", value = mode_differ, n = n_imp_differ)
cat(sprintf("  differ: mode=%d, imputed %d values\n", mode_differ, n_imp_differ))

cat(sprintf("\ncolon 補完後: 完全症例 %d/%d\n",
            sum(complete.cases(colon_prepared)), nrow(colon_prepared)))
```

```{r colon-verify}
stopifnot(all(colon_prepared$status %in% c(0, 1)))
stopifnot(sum(is.na(colon_prepared)) == 0)
cat("colon: status 0/1 check PASS, no missing values\n")
```

```{r rotterdam-prep}
rot <- survival::rotterdam

rotterdam_prepared <- rot[, c("age", "meno", "size", "grade", "nodes",
                              "pgr", "er", "hormon", "chemo", "rtime", "recur")]
names(rotterdam_prepared)[names(rotterdam_prepared) == "rtime"] <- "time"
names(rotterdam_prepared)[names(rotterdam_prepared) == "recur"] <- "status"

rotterdam_prepared$size <- as.character(rotterdam_prepared$size)

n_after_rot <- nrow(rotterdam_prepared)
events_after_rot <- sum(rotterdam_prepared$status)

cat(sprintf("rotterdam: N=%d, events=%d, covariates=%d\n",
            n_after_rot, events_after_rot, ncol(rotterdam_prepared) - 2))
cat(sprintf("rotterdam: 欠損値=%d\n", sum(is.na(rotterdam_prepared))))

stopifnot(all(rotterdam_prepared$status %in% c(0, 1)))
stopifnot(sum(is.na(rotterdam_prepared)) == 0)
cat("rotterdam: status 0/1 check PASS, no missing values\n")
```

```{r flchain-prep}
fl <- survival::flchain

flchain_prepared <- fl[, c("age", "sex", "sample.yr", "kappa", "lambda",
                            "creatinine", "mgus", "futime", "death")]
names(flchain_prepared)[names(flchain_prepared) == "futime"] <- "time"
names(flchain_prepared)[names(flchain_prepared) == "death"] <- "status"

flchain_prepared$sex <- as.character(flchain_prepared$sex)

n_before_fl <- nrow(flchain_prepared)
n_missing_fl <- sum(!complete.cases(flchain_prepared))

flchain_prepared <- flchain_prepared[complete.cases(flchain_prepared), ]

n_after_fl <- nrow(flchain_prepared)
events_after_fl <- sum(flchain_prepared$status)

cat(sprintf("flchain: N=%d → %d (CCA, %d行除外), events=%d, covariates=%d\n",
            n_before_fl, n_after_fl, n_missing_fl,
            events_after_fl, ncol(flchain_prepared) - 2))
cat(sprintf("flchain: 欠損値=%d\n", sum(is.na(flchain_prepared))))

stopifnot(all(flchain_prepared$status %in% c(0, 1)))
stopifnot(sum(is.na(flchain_prepared)) == 0)
cat("flchain: status 0/1 check PASS, no missing values\n")
```

```{r baseline-cox-setup}
cox_formula_lung <- Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + ph.ecog + ph.karno +
  pat.karno + meal.cal + wt.loss
cox_formula_pbc <- Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + trt + ascites + hepato +
  spiders + edema + bili + chol + albumin + copper + alk.phos + ast +
  trig + platelet + protime + stage
cox_formula_colon <- Surv(time, status) ~ sex + age + obstruct + perfor +
  adhere + nodes + differ + extent + surg + node4 + rx
cox_formula_rotterdam <- Surv(time, status) ~ age + meno + size + grade +
  nodes + pgr + er + hormon + chemo
cox_formula_flchain <- Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + sample.yr + kappa +
  lambda + creatinine + mgus
```

```{r cox-lung}
            summary_lung$concordance["C"], summary_lung$concordance["se(C)"]))
print(summary_lung)
```

```{r baseline-results}
extract_cox_results <- function(model, dataset_name) {
  s <- summary(model)
  coefs <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  coefs$variable <- rownames(coefs)
  coefs$dataset <- dataset_name
  coefs$HR <- coefs[["exp(coef)"]]
  coefs$beta <- coefs[["coef"]]
  coefs$se <- coefs[["se(coef)"]]
  coefs$z <- coefs[["z"]]
  coefs$p_value <- coefs[["Pr(>|z|)"]]
  coefs$c_index <- s$concordance["C"]
  coefs$c_index_se <- s$concordance["se(C)"]

  coefs[, c("dataset", "variable", "beta", "HR", "se", "z", "p_value",
            "c_index", "c_index_se")]
}

baseline_results <- bind_rows(
  extract_cox_results(cox_lung, "lung"),
  extract_cox_results(cox_pbc, "pbc"),
  extract_cox_results(cox_colon, "colon"),
  extract_cox_results(cox_rotterdam, "rotterdam"),
  extract_cox_results(cox_flchain, "flchain")
)

kable(baseline_results, digits = 4, caption = "ベースライン Cox 回帰結果")
```

```{r baseline-c-index-summary}
c_index_summary <- baseline_results %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    c_index = first(c_index),
    c_index_se = first(c_index_se),
    n_significant = sum(p_value < 0.05),
    n_covariates = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
kable(c_index_summary, digits = 4, caption = "ベースライン C-index サマリー")
```

```{r save-prepared}
out_dir <- "/home/rstudio/project/data/01_prepared"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

datasets <- list(
  lung = lung_prepared,
  pbc = pbc_prepared,
  colon = colon_prepared,
  rotterdam = rotterdam_prepared,
  flchain = flchain_prepared
)

for (ds_name in names(datasets)) {
  ds <- datasets[[ds_name]]

  write_csv(ds, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_prepared.csv", ds_name)))
  write_parquet(ds, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_prepared.parquet", ds_name)))
  write.xlsx(ds, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_prepared.xlsx", ds_name)))

  cat(sprintf("%s: saved CSV/Parquet/XLSX (N=%d, cols=%d)\n",
              ds_name, nrow(ds), ncol(ds)))
}

write_csv(baseline_results, file.path(out_dir, "baseline_cox_results.csv"))
cat(sprintf("\nBaseline Cox results saved: %d rows\n", nrow(baseline_results)))
```

```{r verify-outputs}
expected_files <- c(
  "lung_prepared.csv", "lung_prepared.parquet", "lung_prepared.xlsx",
  "pbc_prepared.csv", "pbc_prepared.parquet", "pbc_prepared.xlsx",
  "colon_prepared.csv", "colon_prepared.parquet", "colon_prepared.xlsx",
  "rotterdam_prepared.csv", "rotterdam_prepared.parquet", "rotterdam_prepared.xlsx",
  "flchain_prepared.csv", "flchain_prepared.parquet", "flchain_prepared.xlsx",
  "baseline_cox_results.csv"
)
raw_files <- c("lung_raw.csv", "pbc_raw.csv", "colon_raw.csv")

cat("=== data/01_prepared/ ===\n")
for (f in expected_files) {
  path <- file.path(out_dir, f)
  exists <- file.exists(path)
  size <- if (exists) file.info(path)$size else NA
  cat(sprintf("  [%s] %s (%s bytes)\n",
              ifelse(exists, "OK", "MISSING"), f,
              ifelse(is.na(size), "N/A", format(size, big.mark = ","))))
}

cat("\n=== data/raw/ ===\n")
for (f in raw_files) {
  path <- file.path(raw_dir, f)
  exists <- file.exists(path)
  size <- if (exists) file.info(path)$size else NA
  cat(sprintf("  [%s] %s (%s bytes)\n",
              ifelse(exists, "OK", "MISSING"), f,
              ifelse(is.na(size), "N/A", format(size, big.mark = ","))))
}
```
